reason: The policy defines 'Modify items' as changing items to 'an available new item of the same product but of different product option.' The candidate call passes empty new_item_ids, representing removal rather than modification to an alternative variant. The policy explicitly requires modification TO an available new item; removal of items without replacement is not authorized under the 'Modify items' provisions. The policy does support cancellation of entire orders (via cancel_pending_order with a specific reason), but not selective item removal from a pending order via the modify operation.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
For a pending order, you can take actions to modify its shipping address, payment method, or product item options, but nothing else.
